scope: Proposition 7.1 of the manuscript “A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound” (preprints/A-power-improvement-in-the-Heilbronn-triangle-lower-bound-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 191 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e43687a84b82e23f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the lattice Λ and weight W above, let Z be the set of integer 3 × 3 matrices whose columns belong to B, whose rows belong to Λ, whose determinant is zero, and whose three projected columns are pairwise distinct. Then ∑ A∈Z W(A) ≪ log(2N) N6 I2 . (7.1) The implied constant is independent of the fixed digit matrix C.
